The noise easuring equipment used was as follows:
1. B & K Type 2207, Sound Level Meter
2. B & K Type 4230, Acoustic Calibrator
3. B & K Type UA 0207, Windscreen
The existing noise measurement at each of the seventy-seven (77) representative receivers was conducted by the following procedure:
   Sound-level readings were taken at five (5) foot height above ground level at a point where the building structure or noise sensitive land use activity was closest to the existing roadway.
   Sound-level readings were taken at five (5) second intervals until at least one hundred and eighty (180) readings were obtained, approximately fifteen minutes.
3. An L10 measured sound-level was computed graphically for each building by use of a frequency magnitude histogram.
4. The L10 measured sound-level was designated at the level which was equalled or exceeded for ten percent (10%) of the events measured. The estimated confidence interval in the measured noise at a 95% confidence level is ±2dBA.<sup>3</sup>
Exhibit "13" shows the measured ambient L10 noise levels (dBA) for the seventy-seven (77) representative developed land-uses, the starting time and day of measurement at each receiver and other pertinent classification data for each receiver. Exhibit "12" shows the locations of the seventy-seven (77) suspect noise susceptible buildings or structures, representative of the area land uses.
